seo.title: Convert WebM to MP4 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert WebM to MP4 in your browser: the video is re-encoded as H.264 with AAC audio. Free, with no sign-up, and the file isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert WebM to MP4

tool.subtitle: Turn a WebM video into an MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio, in your browser.

faqs.question: What video and audio does the MP4 contain?
faqs.answer: The video is re-encoded as H.264 and the sound as AAC at 96 kbps, so the MP4 plays in the apps and browsers that list MP4 support.

faqs.question: Is the MP4 limited in size or speed?
faqs.answer: Yes, at the top end. Frames are scaled down when the longer side passes 1920 px, and a WebM above 30 fps is capped at 30 fps. Smaller values stay as they are.

faqs.question: Why does a long WebM take a while?
faqs.answer: FFmpeg runs as single-threaded WebAssembly in your browser, and the page sets no timeout. A long video takes as long as your device needs.

faqs.question: What does a failed conversion mean?
faqs.answer: You see an FFmpeg error with an exit code. The file may not be a valid WebM, or it may hold a stream FFmpeg can't read.

fromFormat.name: WebM
fromFormat.description: An open media format designed for the web, based on a subset of Matroska. It carries VP8, VP9 or AV1 video with Vorbis or Opus audio.

toFormat.name: MP4
toFormat.description: A container format that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting WebM to MP4
points: The video is re-encoded as H.264 with AAC audio at 96 kbps.
Frame size is capped at 1920 px on the longer side, and the frame rate at 30 fps.
Converting several WebM files gives one MP4 for each.
Your original WebM isn't changed: you download a new MP4.
FFmpeg runs in your browser, so a long video takes as long as your device needs.

seo.title: Convert HEIC to PNG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert HEIC photos from an iPhone to PNG in your browser. The image is decoded to 8-bit pixels and saved losslessly. Free, with no sign-up.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert HEIC to PNG

tool.subtitle: Save an iPhone HEIC photo as a lossless PNG, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Why is the PNG larger than the HEIC?
faqs.answer: HEIC uses lossy HEVC compression, while PNG is lossless. The PNG stores the decoded pixels exactly, so it can take much more space than the HEIC.

faqs.question: Are camera details like EXIF kept in the PNG?
faqs.answer: No. libheif hands the browser plain pixels, and a PNG written from them carries no camera details: EXIF data, including the capture date, and the colour profile are left behind.

faqs.question: What happens if the HEIC holds more than one image?
faqs.answer: Only the primary image is decoded, so you get one PNG. Other images stored in the same file are not converted.

faqs.question: Why does it say "No images in HEIF"?
faqs.answer: The file has no image the decoder can read. Check that it is a real HEIC photo and not a renamed file.

faqs.question: Does the PNG keep the HEIC's 10-bit colour?
faqs.answer: No. HEIC can hold 10-bit colour, but the converter decodes to 8-bit RGB pixels, so the PNG has 8 bits per channel.

fromFormat.name: HEIC
fromFormat.description: HEIF images coded with HEVC, the default photo format on iPhone since iOS 11. The heic brand is defined in ISO/IEC 23008-12, the HEIF standard.
details: Smaller files than JPEG at similar quality

toFormat.name: PNG
toFormat.description: A lossless raster image format developed in the mid-1990s as a patent-free replacement for GIF and standardized as ISO/IEC 15948 and a W3C Recommendation.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting HEIC to PNG
points: The PNG has 8 bits per channel, decoded from the HEIC's pixels.
EXIF data and ICC profiles aren't carried over.
Only the primary image of a HEIC is converted, so you get one PNG.
Converting several HEIC files gives one PNG for each.
libheif decodes the photo in your browser, so it isn't uploaded.

seo.title: Convert MP3 to WAV Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert MP3 to WAV in your browser: the audio is decoded to 16-bit PCM. Free, with no sign-up, and the file isn't uploaded to a server.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert MP3 to WAV

tool.subtitle: Decode an MP3 into an uncompressed 16-bit WAV file, in your browser.

faqs.question: Will the WAV sound better than the MP3?
faqs.answer: No. MP3 is lossy, and decoding it can't bring back what compression removed. The WAV holds the MP3's sound as it is.

faqs.question: Why is the WAV so much bigger than the MP3?
faqs.answer: WAV usually holds uncompressed PCM audio, so files are large but exact. This converter writes 16-bit PCM, which takes far more space than a compressed MP3.

faqs.question: Is there a size limit for the WAV?
faqs.answer: The WAV format has a 4 GB file size limit. The converter adds no limit of its own, so a very long MP3 can reach that format limit.

faqs.question: What if the MP3 won't convert?
faqs.answer: You see an FFmpeg error with an exit code. The file may be damaged or not really an MP3, so check that it plays first.

fromFormat.name: MP3
fromFormat.description: A lossy audio format standardized by MPEG (ISO/IEC 11172-3), developed with major contributions from the Fraunhofer Society. It became the most common format for downloadable music.

toFormat.name: WAV
toFormat.description: An audio container format developed by Microsoft and IBM that is based on RIFF. It usually holds uncompressed PCM audio, so files are large but exact.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting MP3 to WAV
points: The WAV holds 16-bit PCM audio decoded from the MP3.
Converting can't restore quality the MP3 already lost.
Expect a much larger file than the MP3.
Converting several MP3 files gives one WAV for each.
FFmpeg runs in your browser, so the MP3 isn't uploaded.

seo.title: Convert JPG to JPEG Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert JPG to JPEG in your browser. The image is decoded and saved again as a JPEG at quality 0.85. Free, with no sign-up, no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JPG to JPEG

tool.subtitle: Save a JPG image as a JPEG file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Is there a difference between JPG and JPEG?
faqs.answer: No. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format, so the picture type doesn't change when you convert.

faqs.question: Does converting JPG to JPEG change the picture?
faqs.answer: Slightly. The converter doesn't just rename the file: it decodes the pixels and encodes a new JPEG at quality 0.85, and JPEG is lossy.

faqs.question: Does the JPEG keep the photo's camera and location data?
faqs.answer: No. Only pixels are passed on, so EXIF, ICC profile and XMP data are dropped from the new JPEG.

faqs.question: Is my original JPG replaced?
faqs.answer: No. Your JPG isn't changed. You download a new JPEG next to it, and the conversion can be repeated from the same file.

fromFormat.name: JPG
fromFormat.description: A lossy raster image format defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1), designed for photographs. .jpg and .jpeg are the same format.

toFormat.name: JPEG
toFormat.description: The same format as JPG, defined by the Joint Photographic Experts Group (ISO/IEC 10918-1) and designed for photographs.

Your browser does the work, so the image isn't uploaded.

seo.title: Compress PNG Files Online (Free)
seo.description: Compress PNG files in your browser with lossless oxipng recompression. If the result isn't smaller, you get your original back. Free, no sign-up.

tool.subtitle: Make a PNG file smaller without changing its pixels, in your browser.

faqs.question: Does compressing a PNG lower its quality?
faqs.answer: No. The PNG goes through oxipng at level 1, which is lossless, so the pixels stay the same and only the way they are stored changes.

faqs.question: What if the compressed PNG isn't smaller?
faqs.answer: You get your original file back. The compressor only returns a result that is smaller than the file you chose.

faqs.question: Can I compress several PNG files at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose them together and they run one after another. Each one downloads as its own file, not as a ZIP.

faqs.question: Is there a limit on PNG file size?
faqs.answer: The page sets no size limit of its own. It runs in a Web Worker on your device, so a large PNG takes as long as your device needs.

pairNotes.title: What to know before compressing a PNG
points: Compression is lossless: oxipng at level 1 keeps the pixels as they are.
If the result isn't smaller, you get the original back.
Your original file isn't changed: you download a new copy.

seo.title: Convert GIF to MP4 Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert GIF to MP4 in your browser: the animation is re-encoded as H.264 video. Free, with no sign-up, and the file isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert GIF to MP4

tool.subtitle: Turn an animated GIF into an H.264 MP4 video, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Can you convert a GIF to MP4?
faqs.answer: Yes. FFmpeg runs in your browser and re-encodes the GIF's frames as H.264 video in an MP4 file.

faqs.question: What size and frame rate does the MP4 have?
faqs.answer: It follows the GIF, with two caps: 1920 px on the longer side and 30 fps. A GIF within those limits keeps its size and frame rate.

faqs.question: Does the MP4 still loop like a GIF?
faqs.answer: The conversion sets no loop option, and an MP4 carries no loop flag of its own, so whether it repeats is up to the player you open it with.

faqs.question: What if the GIF fails to convert?
faqs.answer: You see an FFmpeg error with an exit code. Check that the file really is a GIF, then try again.

fromFormat.name: GIF
fromFormat.description: A raster image format introduced by CompuServe in 1987. It uses LZW compression, a palette of at most 256 colours per frame, and supports simple animation.

toFormat.name: MP4
toFormat.description: A container format defined in ISO/IEC 14496-14 that can hold video, audio, subtitles and metadata. H.264 video with AAC audio is the most common combination.

pairNotes.title: What to know before converting GIF to MP4
points: The animation is re-encoded as H.264 video in an MP4 file.

seo.description: Convert JPG to WebP in your browser. The image is decoded and saved again as a WebP at quality 0.85. Free, with no sign-up, no upload.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert JPG to WebP

tool.subtitle: Save a JPG photo as a WebP image, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Does converting JPG to WebP lose quality?
faqs.answer: Some. The JPG is decoded to pixels and written as a new WebP at quality 0.85, so it is encoded a second time with lossy compression.

faqs.question: Is the camera data copied to the WebP?
faqs.answer: Nothing but pixels reaches the WebP. EXIF, ICC profile and XMP details from the JPG are left behind.

faqs.question: Will the WebP open everywhere?
faqs.answer: WebP is supported by current major browsers, and Preview on macOS, GIMP and Windows Photos open it.

faqs.question: What if the browser can't open my JPG?
faqs.answer: The page shows "Image decode failed." or says your browser can't open the file. Try a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

seo.title: Convert WebP to GIF Online (Free)
seo.description: Convert WebP to GIF in your browser. An animated WebP gives only its first frame. Free, with no sign-up, and the image isn't uploaded.
seo.howToHeading: How to convert WebP to GIF

tool.subtitle: Save a WebP image as a GIF file, right in your browser.

faqs.question: Will an animated WebP stay animated as a GIF?
faqs.answer: No. An animated WebP gives its first frame only, so the GIF is a still image. This converter doesn't carry the animation over.

faqs.question: Why do the colours look different in the GIF?
faqs.answer: GIF uses a palette of at most 256 colours per frame, while WebP can hold many more. A photo with smooth colour changes can look different.

faqs.question: Is transparency kept in the GIF?
faqs.answer: GIF supports 1-bit transparency, not the smooth alpha transparency of WebP. The converter lists transparency as kept for PNG and WebP outputs only.

faqs.question: Why does it say "Image decode failed"?
faqs.answer: Your browser could not read the file as an image. Check that it is a real WebP, or try a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
